name: Cryptoprocessing by CoinsPaid for Woocommerce – Cryptocurrency Payment Gateway
author: Cryptoprocessing by CoinsPaid

sections.description:
CryptoProcessing by CoinsPaid is the easiest way to accept cryptocurrency payments in your WordPress store. Whether you run a global e-commerce site or a niche product page, CryptoProcessing by CoinsPaid gives your customers the ability to pay in 20+ leading digital currencies – while you receive settlements in over 40 fiat currencies, directly to your bank account or crypto wallet.

Why Choose CryptoProcessing by CoinsPaid for WordPress?

  • Simple Checkout Experience
    Your customers choose crypto at checkout, scan a QR code, and the transaction is complete. No redirects, no additional steps.

  • Instant Access to Funds
    CryptoProcessing enables fast deposits and real-time conversions, so your cash flow never stalls.

  • Built for Business
    Secure, compliant, and easy to manage from your WordPress dashboard. No crypto experience required.

  • Transparent transaction fees
    You only pay per transaction, with fees tailored to your business model. No setup or monthly charges.

  • Licensed in Estonia
    We’re officially registered in Estonia, following strict EU rules on security, KYC, and anti-money laundering

Designed for business growth

  • Instant access to funds
    Settle payments quickly and avoid cash flow delays — use your earnings to restock, scale ads, or cover operating costs right away.

  • Auto conversion to fiat or stablecoins
    Protect your business from volatility by converting crypto payments to local currencies in real time, with locked-in exchange rates.

  • Secure and compliant
    Transactions are protected by multi-layered security, including two-factor authentication, fraud monitoring, and transaction screening tools.

  • Flexible withdrawals
    Receive payouts in your bank account (via SEPA/SWIFT) or store crypto securely in cold wallets.

  • Convenient dashboarding
    Full reporting dashboard with balance tracking, deposits, and statements.

Supported currencies

  • Cryptocurrencies: BTC, ETH, USDC, BNB, XRP, ADA, DOGE, SOL, LTC, BCH, TRX, and more
  • Fiat: EUR, USD, and 40+ others

For more details on supported currencies, networks, and conversion pairs, visit CryptoProcessing Docs.

Security & fraud protection

Keep your transactions secure with multiple layers of protection designed to prevent unauthorized payments and fraud:
– Two-factor authentication: Adds an extra verification step to keep your account and funds safe.
– Fraud monitoring: Detects and blocks suspicious transactions in real time.
– Access-level permissions: Control who can manage payments and withdrawals to prevent unauthorized actions.
– Transaction screening: All transactions undergo screening using two reputable transaction monitoring tools.

Installation Instruction

  1. Sign up at CryptoProcessing.comto create your merchant account.

  2. Download the Cryptoprocessing by CoinsPaid for Woocommerce – Cryptocurrency Payment Gateway plugin from the WordPress directory.

  3. From your WordPress admin panel, go to Plugins > Add New and upload the plugin ZIP file.

  4. Activate the plugin and enter your CryptoProcessing API credentials.

  5. Set your payment preferences and you’re ready to go.

Feel free to contact Sales sales@cryptoprocessing.com or our Support team support@cryptoprocessing.com if you have any questions.

About

CryptoProcessing by CoinsPaid is a regulated cryptocurrency payment provider with over 10 years of industry experience. We’re licensed in Estonia and Poland, and operate across multiple countries worldwide. Each month, we process more than 800,000 transactions, with a total volume exceeding €700 million.

Our flagship product — a crypto payment gateway — allows businesses to accept over 20 popular digital currencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins. We also offer fast, secure settlements straight to merchants’ bank accounts in euros, US dollars, and other fiat currencies. Hundreds of businesses across different sectors use our platform to streamline payments, cut costs, and reach the growing base of crypto users.

In addition to payment processing, we offer a full suite of supporting tools — including a crypto business wallet, an OTC desk, and a hot wallet — designed to make handling crypto payments simple, secure, and efficient.

Third Party API & License Information

CoinsPaid Website: https://coinspaid.com/
Cryptoprocessing: [https://cryptoprocessing.com/] (https://cryptoprocessing.com/)
API docs: https://docs.cryptoprocessing.com/
Privacy policy: https://coinspaid.com/privacypolicy/
Term of Use: https://coinspaid.com/terms-of-use/

Legal notes

For details on the data we collect and how it’s managed, please visit our privacy policy and AML policy

FAQ

Q: Do I need to be familiar with crypto to use this plugin?
A: Not at all. The plugin is designed for merchants of all backgrounds. You manage payments just like any other payment method – we handle the crypto part for you.
Q: How do I receive my funds?
A: You choose how to receive your earnings – in crypto (cold storage) or fiat (to your bank via SEPA/SWIFT).
Q: How quickly are transactions processed?
A: Most crypto deposits are available almost instantly, especially for account-based coins like USDC or USDT.
Q: Are there any setup or subscription fees?
A: No. Plugin integration is free – you only pay per transaction, with fees capped at 1.5%.
Q: Is this secure?
A: Yes. Transactions are protected with two-factor authentication, real-time fraud detection, and dual-layer transaction monitoring.
Q: What if I need help?
A: Our support team is ready to assist. Just email support@cryptoprocessing.com or contact us through the Widget in your CryptoProcessing back office.
Q: What cryptocurrencies are accepted?
A: We support over 20 leading cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USD Coin, Litecoin, and others. For more information on supported currencies, networks, and conversion pairs, please visit CryptoProcessing Docs.
Q: What fiat currencies can I use in order to withdraw money from my merchant account to my fiat bank account?
A: We currently support withdrawals in EUR and USD
sections.installation:
Sign up & set up your merchant account

  • To use Plugin, you must first operate with CoinsPaid Back Office – Sign up at CryptoProcessing.comto create your merchant account.
  • Once registered, log in to your CryptoProcessing back office.

Generate your API credentials

  • In your merchant settings, navigate to API Keys. For security, we recommend creating a new merchant profile specifically for plugin use.
  • Click Generate API Key, enter your 2FA code, and then confirm.
  • Once generated, click Activate, enter your 2FA again, and save your Secret Key securely — it will only be shown once.
  • Set your callback URL as follows: http://your_site_url/wp-json/coinspaid/v1/webhook (replace your_site_url with the correct values for your site). Make sure this URL matches the one used in the plugin settings — this keeps the payment status synced.

Attention! Keep your Secret Key safe — you won’t be able to view it again.

Install the plugin on WooCommerce

  • Download the CryptoProcessing plugin ZIP file from the marketplace.
  • In your CMS admin panel, go to Plugins > Add New.
  • Upload the ZIP file and install the plugin.
  • Once installed, activate it from your plugin list.

Enter your credentials & configure payment settings

  • In your admin panel, go to the plugin’s settings section.
  • Insert your Secret Key and Public Key in the appropriate fields.

Set payment preferences and go live

  • Choose which cryptocurrencies to accept (Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDC, and more).
  • Set up your fiat settlement preferences (EUR, USD, etc.).
  • Save your settings — you’re ready to start accepting crypto payments!
